title: useDebugValue: label a Hook in DevTools

slides.say: Use debug value adds a readable label to your custom Hook in React DevTools.
Call it at the top level of your custom Hook. Inspect a component using it, and DevTools shows Online Status: Online.
Formatting is expensive? Pass a formatting function as the second argument. DevTools only calls it when the component is inspected.

slides.text: Only for custom Hooks. It returns nothing.
slides.say: It returns nothing. It is only a hint for DevTools.
